summary: Approximately 92,225 km² and about 10.3 million people (2021), from Wikidata's Q45 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Portugal", at revision 1376081855, opens: "Portugal, officially the Portuguese Republic, is a country in Southwestern Europe. Mainland Portugal is located on the southwestern portion of the Iberian Peninsula, and bordered by Spain to the north and east. Portugal also includes the archipelagos of Madeira and the Azores in the Atlantic Ocean." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 235 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1886 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Lisbon. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
